description: Sizing rules and default presets. Every coefficient the solvers use lives here or in a catalog entry. Default models are the largest-capacity entry per category whose required values are all known, preferring products with published specs over announced ones.

derate.note: continuous-load factor for busway, switchgear and transformer ratings (NEC 80% rule style); edit per project

cp_j_kgk.note: standard property of water at about 25 C

density_kg_m3.note: standard property of water at about 20 C

cp_j_kgk.note: typical published value for 25% PG at about 25 C

density_kg_m3.note: typical published value for 25% PG at about 25 C

cp_j_kgk.note: typical published value for 40% PG at about 25 C

density_kg_m3.note: typical published value for 40% PG at about 25 C

facility_delta_t_k.note: facility water loop rise across CDUs; typical warm-water design range 6-10 K

max_velocity_m_s.note: common upper limit for large chilled/condenser water mains to limit erosion and noise

fittings_factor.note: equivalent length multiplier for fittings and valves on straight runs

facility_pump_head_kpa.note: available facility loop pump head; replace with the selected pump

rack_manifold_drop_kpa.note: row manifold, hoses and quick disconnects between CDU and rack

slack_fraction.note: cable slack and service loops as a fraction of routed length

drop_m.note: vertical run from tray to port at each end

propagation_ns_per_m.note: light in fiber about 5 ns/m (product spec); copper slightly lower

message_bytes.note: message size for the base latency figure (product spec example)

nic_overhead_ns.note: NIC plus software overhead per message, 'typically a microsecond or more' (product spec)

max_oversubscription.note: highest acceptable leaf down:up ratio under N-1; AI training fabrics usually target 1:1
